description: Launch the Liverpool Cancer iChart Archive app. Navigate to the cancer drug 'Dabrafenib' in the drug list. Once on Dabrafenib's page, find and open the 'Antifungal agents' (or 'Antifungals') co-medication therapeutic category. Within that category, locate 'Ketoconazole' and tap on it to check the drug-drug interaction. Leave the screen showing the interaction result (traffic-light color indicator) for Dabrafenib + Ketoconazole. The expected interaction severity is red or orange.
